verdict.rationale: Resend's llms.txt says users can "build recurring flows with automations" for marketing email, which is a first-party recurring-workflow capability, but it is only a single thin mention. The documented broadcast scheduling ("Schedule email to be sent later") is a one-off delayed send, not a recurring schedule, so it adds no credit here. Missing for 10: documented recurring schedule definitions (cron/intervals), automation triggers and configuration docs, API/CLI/MCP control of recurring jobs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
